description: This file defines the Bestseller model class within the OpenCart extension, providing functionality to retrieve the list of best-selling products based on a specified limit.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Model class for handling bestsellers in the OpenCart catalog, extending the Product class and providing a method to fetch top-selling products.

methods.name: getBestSellers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of best-selling products up to the specified limit, using caching to optimize database access.
